name: Cra Shortcut Over Cra Fixture
description: Made up for scripts/scenario.sh: the toolbar popup's shortcut is Command+Shift+O, as Obsidian Web Clipper's is, a key Cra also has (Show Little Window 'Open In' Menu, from Arc) for a command that runs only while a Little Window is in front (GitHub #744). The popup loads a fixture page to say it opened.
